column2: How many paid holidays do full-time employees receive each year?
column3: 11 paid holidays plus 2 floating holidays (16 hours) per calendar year.

column2: How many vacation days does a new full-time employee receive?
column3: 15 days (120 hours) annually for employees with less than 2 years of service; 4.62 hours accrued per pay period.

column2: When can a new employee start using accrued vacation?
column3: On day 91 after the 90-day introductory period; earlier use requires manager approval.

column2: How much paid sick leave do full-time employees receive?
column3: 80 hours (10 days) per calendar year; up to 40 unused hours may carry over.

column2: How many weeks of paid parental leave are available to birth and non-birth parents?
column3: After 6 months of service, eligible full-time birth parents receive 16 weeks at 100% base pay; non-birth, adoptive, and foster parents receive 12 weeks at 100% base pay.

column2: What is the maximum company 401(k) match?
column3: 5% of eligible pay: 100% match on first 4% contributed and 50% match on next 2%.

column2: What is the required onsite schedule for hybrid employees?
column3: At least 3 days per week, with Tuesday through Thursday as anchor days.

column2: What home office stipend do remote and hybrid employees receive?
column3: A one-time $500 home office setup stipend and $75 per month for internet and phone.

column2: What is the annual tuition reimbursement limit?
column3: Up to $5,250 per calendar year for job-related degrees or certifications, subject to pre-approval, grade requirements, and a 12-month continued-employment requirement or prorated repayment.

column2: What is the severance policy for an employee with 5 years of service who is laid off?
column3: 10 weeks of base pay (2 weeks per year of service), subject to signing a separation agreement.

column2: If I take 5 consecutive vacation days, how far in advance must I submit the request?
column3: At least 4 weeks in advance via Workday; managers respond within 3 business days.

column2: If a non-exempt employee works 45 hours in a week, what overtime rate applies?
column3: Generally 5 hours at 1.5 times the regular hourly rate for hours over 40 per workweek; California additionally specifies double time for hours worked over 12 in a single day.

column2: Can an employee work from another country for 30 business days?
column3: The stated allowance is up to 20 business days per calendar year from another U.S. state or country with manager and People Operations approval. A 30-day arrangement is outside the stated allowance; no exception process is specified.

column2: If an employee resigns, will unused vacation and sick leave be paid out?
column3: Accrued unused vacation is paid at the final base rate regardless of separation reason. Sick leave is not paid out except where required by state law.

column2: What must an employee do after losing a company laptop?
column3: Report the lost or stolen device within 1 hour of discovery to security@northwinddynamics.example or Slack channel #security-incident.
